Messages.Author: tigernat1
Messages.Body:
If an acting minion chooses Bundi as his strike and the blocking
minion plays Canine Horde at superior as her strike, does the acting
minion still do hand damage or does he have no strike?

Bundi
Strike: hand strike for strength+1 damage. (This strike is both a hand
strike and a melee weapon strike). Bearer may prevent 1 damage from
each melee weapon strike made against him or her.

Vegas gNat

Messages.Author: LSJ

> If an acting minion chooses Bundi as his strike and the blocking
